objectives: 使學生對電漿物理有基本的認識,讓學生由粒子及流體觀點了解電漿,認識太空環境中的電漿粒子運動及波動現象
content:
1. 電漿基本性質及尺度
2. 帶電粒子在電磁場中的運動
3. 電漿流體性質
4. 太空環境之各種電漿波動
books:
1. Introduction to Plasma Physics, R. J. Goldston and P. H. Rutherford, Taylor ＆ Francis, 1995.
2. Physics of Space Plasmas: An Introduction, G. K. Parks, Westview Press, 2004.
3. Introduction to plasma physics : with space and laboratory applications, D. A. Gurnett and A. Bhattacharjee, Cambridge University Press, 2005.
4. Elementary Space Plasma Physics, Ling-Hsiao Lyu, 2010.
5. Introduction to Plasma Physics and Controlled Fusion, Volume 1: Plasma Physics, 3rd edition, Francis F. Chen, Springer, 2016.
6. Plasma physics: an introduction to laboratory, space, and fusion plasmas, Alexander Piel, 2nd edition, Springer, 2017.
grading_policy:
作業: 20％
報告: 20％
筆試: 50％ (兩次考試各佔25％)
上課表現: 10％
隨堂: extra
